_comment: Professions and their gathering stations (GDD 5.4, systems.md 5.1-5.2). Rates are units per hour and caps are the most a station holds; both are scaled by economy.pace.time_multiplier.

professions.name: Blacksmith
professions.description: Mine copper and iron, forge brass fittings every crafter needs, and make lanterns and tournament swords.
professions.needs_from_others: Smelting Flux (Alchemist) and Leather Grips (Leatherworker) for the iron tier.

professions.name: Alchemist
professions.description: Grow sunleaf and ember moss, brew the city's healing draughts, and supply the fluxes and solutions other guilds rely on.

professions.name: Leatherworker
professions.description: Send trappers out for hides, stitch grips and satchels, and craft armour for the tournament crowd.
professions.needs_from_others: Tanning Solution (Alchemist) and Brass Fittings (Blacksmith) for the higher tier.
